entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: A crazed, wicked, powerful planeswalker who initiated the Planeswalker War; betrayed in youth, he dedicated himself to vengeance.

entities.name: Faralyn
entities.description: A planeswalker to whom Ravidel was apprenticed, who sacrificed Ravidel's life energy to escape the Shard.

entities.name: Rhuell
entities.description: An Elder Dragonling held by Faralyn, Ravidel's friend, slain at the Null Moon summit.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: A planeswalker who plotted at the summit and is Ravidel's chief target of vengeance.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: A planeswalker who plotted at the summit and was trapped in Phyrexia by Ravidel and Taysir.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: A planeswalker who resurrected Ravidel, became his enemy, and later mentored and loved Jared.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: A powerful planeswalker who took Ravidel as spellsquire, loved Kristina, and was slain by Feroz.

entities.name: Embereck
entities.description: A powerful Dominarian planeswalker who let Ravidel leave with the Sylex and later vowed vengeance.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Adam Carthalion's son, robbed by Ravidel of his life, who became Kristina's student and lover and led the fight against Ravidel.

entities.name: Adam Carthalion
entities.description: A Corondoran lord corrupted and killed by Ravidel at Aster Fall.

entities.name: Liana
entities.description: A planeswalker forced into Ravidel's servitude who died at his hands.

entities.name: Altair
entities.description: A planeswalker forced into Ravidel's servitude who died at his hands.

entities.name: Grenfell Mor
entities.description: A planeswalker blackmailed into Ravidel's servitude.

entities.name: Sandruu
entities.description: A young planeswalking minotaur, Kristina's lover, banished for centuries by Taysir.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: The guardian of the Homelands who slew Taysir.

entities.name: Scarlet Vizier
entities.description: A figure slain in the destruction of Arathoxia.

entities.name: Argivian Sylex
entities.description: A fabled artifact Ravidel won from Embereck and used to blackmail the planeswalkers.

entities.name: Moxes
entities.description: Powerful magical artifacts Ravidel secured to activate a Mox Beacon.

entities.name: Summit of the Null Moon
entities.description: The gathering at which Faralyn, Szat and Leshrac manipulated planeswalkers into fighting, killing Rhuell and Ravidel.

entities.name: Planeswalker War
entities.description: The war Ravidel initiated by drawing planeswalkers to Dominaria.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: The Dominarian continent where Ravidel gathered his power.

entities.name: Arathoxia
entities.description: A Corondoran city Ravidel destroyed.

events.summary: Ravidel is apprenticed to the planeswalker Faralyn to escape the calamities threatening his people.
events.quote: his parents thought it best to apprentice the young magician to the planeswalker Faralyn

events.summary: At the Summit of the Null Moon, Faralyn, Szat and Leshrac manipulate the planeswalkers into fighting; Rhuell and Ravidel are killed.
Faralyn uses Ravidel's life energy to escape the Shard, leaving his corpse behind.
events.quote: Faralyn used his spellsquire's life energy to escape from the Shard

events.summary: Kristina resurrects Ravidel with a fully manifested spark; betrayed and grieving, he goes insane and curses her with his enmity.
events.quote: Kristina of the Woods cast a spell of resurrection and revived Ravidel with a fully manifested spark

events.summary: Taysir takes Ravidel on as a spellsquire.
events.quote: took him on as a spellsquire

events.summary: Ravidel and Taysir trap Leshrac in Phyrexia, but Szat stays out of reach.
events.quote: They found Leshrac and trapped him in Phyrexia

events.summary: Embereck defeats Ravidel in a duel over the Sylex but lets him leave with it.
events.quote: Embereck defeated Ravidel but allowed him to leave with the Sylex

events.summary: Ravidel attacks the Summit of Minorad and uses the Sylex to blackmail several planeswalkers into servitude.
events.quote: Ravidel attacked this Summit of Minorad and hatched an insidious plan

events.summary: Only Embereck refuses Ravidel's demand and vanishes with a vow of vengeance.
events.quote: Only Embereck refused and vanished with a vow of vengeance against Ravidel.

events.summary: Ravidel tells Taysir that Kristina has taken a lover, provoking Taysir to attack Sandruu.
events.quote: Ravidel gleefully brought him the news that Kristina had taken a lover

events.summary: On Ulgrotha Sandruu is banished and Taysir is slain by Feroz.
events.quote: Taysir was slain by the guardian of the Homelands, Feroz

events.summary: Ravidel corrupts Lord Adam Carthalion and kills him at the Battle of Aster Fall.
events.quote: He corrupted Lord Adam Carthalion and eventually killed him at the Battle of Aster Fall

events.summary: Ravidel assaults Arathoxia, destroying it and killing the Scarlet Vizier; Jared escapes.
events.quote: Ravidel launched an all-out assault on the city

events.summary: Liana and Altair die at Ravidel's hands, and he secures the Moxes.
Ravidel plans to activate a Mox Beacon to draw his enemies to Dominaria, and succeeds in drawing Szat to Corondor, starting the Planeswalker War.
events.quote: Ravidel was destined to succeed in drawing Szat to Corondor

events.summary: Jared, taught by Kristina and her lover, leads the fight against Ravidel.
events.quote: Jared was taught by Kristina and became her lover

relations.note: Ravidel was apprenticed to him as spellsquire.
relations.quote: to apprentice the young magician to the planeswalker Faralyn

relations.note: Took him on as spellsquire and taught him.
relations.quote: took him on as a spellsquire

relations.note: The dragon and Ravidel became friends.

relations.quote: cursed Kristina with his enmity forever
Ravidel's hatred of Szat burned as strongly as Kristina's

relations.note: Taysir was in love with her.
relations.quote: The planeswalker was in love with her

relations.note: Killed at the Battle of Aster Fall.
relations.quote: He corrupted Lord Adam Carthalion and eventually killed him at the Battle of Aster Fall
Taysir was slain by the guardian of the Homelands, Feroz

relations.note: Jared realized Ravidel was his arch-enemy.
